svg.title: Ryuichi (Ryu) Lun
svg.desc: Hi, I'm Ryu. I build AI agent systems and the backend infrastructure that keeps them fast and reliable. São Paulo, Honolulu, Tokyo, Los Angeles. The diagram shows one message sent over three routes, one of them tampered, with the receiver accepting the majority.
